units.source_text: 催马乐《贯川》全文：“（女唱）莎草生在贯川边，做个枕头软如绵。

en.t: The full text of the saibara song Through the River is: The woman sings: sedge grows by the banks of the Nuki River; make it into a pillow, soft as cotton.

units.source_text: 郎君失却父母欢，没有一夜好安眠。

en.t: The young lord has lost his parents' love, and not for a single night can he sleep in peace.

units.source_text: （女唱）郎君失却父母欢，为此分外可爱怜。

en.t: The woman sings: the young lord has lost his parents' love; for that very reason he is especially dear and pitiful.

units.source_text: （男唱）姐姐把我如此爱，我心感激不可言。

en.t: The man sings: sister, you love me so deeply that my heart is grateful beyond words.

units.source_text: 明天我上矢矧市，一定替你买双鞋。

en.t: Tomorrow I will go to the market at Yahagi, and I will surely buy a pair of shoes for you.

units.source_text: （女唱）你倘买鞋给我穿，要买绸面狭底鞋。

en.t: The woman sings: if you buy shoes for me to wear, buy silk-covered shoes with narrow soles.

units.source_text: 穿上鞋子着好衣，走上官路迎郎来。”

en.t: I will put on the shoes, dress in fine clothes, and go out onto the official road to welcome my lord.
